description: This file defines the EntityGroupReader class which models the <entity-group-reader> XML element in an OFBiz entity configuration. It parses attributes such as name, loader, and location, and manages a list of resource elements associated with it.

classes.name: EntityGroupReader
classes.description: Models the <entity-group-reader> XML element from entity configuration, encapsulating its attributes and resources.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute value of the entity-group-reader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of Resource objects associated with this entity group.
